mapper.select:
SELECT * FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND task_id=#{query.taskId} AND deleted=FALSE AND object_key='INSTALLATION_HISTORY' AND source_object='pm_project_shipment'
AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(fields_json,'$.originalFields.barcode')) IN #{sn} AND 1=0 AND id > #{query.afterId} ORDER BY id LIMIT 500

SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND t.source_system=#{query.sourceSystem} AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND (t.adapter=#{query.adapter} OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_DEVICE_BOOTSTRAP_DIRECT' AND b.object_key='DEVICE_BASE' AND b.source_object='ast_device_shipment')
OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_PROJECT_MASTER_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('pm_project_header','pm_project_identity'))
OR (t.adapter='DPPMS_ORGANIZATION_DIRECT' AND b.object_key IN ('COMPANY','DEPARTMENT','fnd_department','ehr_department','COMPANY_REFERENCE'))
OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','t_user_info','fnd_user_info') AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%')
OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_ROLE','FND_ROLE'))
OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('T_USER_ROLE','FND_USER_ROLE'))
OR (t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND b.object_key IN ('t_user_info','fnd_user_info','fnd_user_power') AND b.source_key LIKE '%:%')
) AND b.source_object=#{query.sourceObject}
AND b.source_key IN #{key}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY b.id

SELECT b.* FROM int_sync_binding b JOIN int_sync_task t ON t.id=b.task_id AND t.tenant_id=b.tenant_id AND t.deleted=FALSE WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND t.source_system='DPPMS' AND t.connection_id=#{query.connectionId} AND t.adapter IN ('DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION','DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION_DIRECT') AND t.adapter='DPPMS_ACCOUNT_FOUNDATION' AND b.object_key IN ('t_user','fnd_user_info') AND b.object_key=b.source_object AND b.source_key NOT LIKE '%:%'
AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(b.fields_json,'$._verifiedEhrEmployeeId')) IN #{employee} AND 1=0 ORDER BY b.id
SELECT id FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId} AND deleted=FALSE LIMIT 1
SELECT /*+ INDEX(b idx_int_binding_task_page) */ COUNT(*) FROM int_sync_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.deleted=FALSE

SELECT /*+ INDEX(b idx_int_binding_task_page) */ b.id,b.tenant_id,b.object_key,b.source_key,b.target_id,b.fields_json,b.last_run_id FROM int_sync_binding b WHERE b.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND b.task_id=#{query.taskId} AND b.id > #{query.afterId} AND b.deleted=FALSE AND b.fields_json LIKE '%"_targets"%' ORDER BY b.id LIMIT #{query.limit} FOR UPDATE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id=#{taskId}
DELETE FROM int_sync_binding WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND task_id IN (SELECT id FROM int_sync_task WHERE tenant_id=#{tenantId} AND adapter=#{adapter})
